about: UPL Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells pesticides, insecticides, and micronutrients in India, Brazil, the United States, the United Kingdom, and internationally. It operates through Crop protection, Seeds & Post-Harvest solutions, and Non-Agro segments.
